property_summary: For any caller and parameters, calling newGrantProposal(...) on the correct contract increases proposalCount by either 1 or (if prior count is max uint) wraps according to Solidity semantics — specifically, after the call proposalCount != prior value; the mutant that omits the increment leaves proposalCount unchanged, so there exist inputs where post-call proposalCount equals pre-call (violating the rule).
change_summary: Do not increment proposalCount at all (remove the increment), leaving proposalCount unchanged after the call and storing grant under current proposalCount, changing observable proposalCount.
